meta.title: Moonpatch Farm — pumpkins, cider donuts & a little fright
meta.description: Walk through the gate of a small (and entirely fictional) pumpkin farm: a cozy café, a red barn full of fall goods and a haunt shop that bites back.

gate.heading: Moonpatch Farm
gate.intro: A pumpkin farm at the end of a dirt road. The gate's right in front of you.
gate.posterAlt: An old wooden gate with a crescent moon on the crossbeam. Behind it, a red barn, a cream café and a dark gray shop stand around a square full of pumpkins.

header.home: Moonpatch Farm, back to the gate
